cobblemarket.auction.rule.1: §6Create§r: starting price must fit the price limits; min increment can be blank to use the server default
cobblemarket.auction.rule.2: §6Withdrawal§r: §clistings cannot be withdrawn§r once created; they run until the timer ends (sold or unsold)
cobblemarket.auction.rule.3: §6Bid§r: must exceed the current price and be at least the min increment above it; §cyou cannot bid on your own auction§r
cobblemarket.auction.rule.4: §6Payment§r: bids are charged instantly; outbid amounts go to your pending balance; raising your own bid only costs the difference
cobblemarket.auction.rule.5: §6Anti-snipe§r: bidding shortly before the end §cextends the timer§r
cobblemarket.auction.rule.6: §6Settle§r: the lot goes to the winner's returns; the seller receives the final price §cminus the fee§r; no bids = returned to the seller
cobblemarket.auction.rule.7: §6Limit§r: active auctions per player are limited by server config

cobblemarket.ban.title: Ban Management
cobblemarket.ban.info_tip:
A ban cuts off the market's trading entries — it does not seize existing assets
Blocked: buying Pokemon, buying items, listing for sale, starting an auction, bidding, buy orders, delivering, claiming a delivery
Not affected: cancelling a listing, collecting returns and pending balance, declining a delivery; Meowth Bank deposits, withdrawals and repayments, and cards
Loans: allowed as usual; blocked only when the ban has "Also block loans" selected

cobblemarket.finance.title: Finance
cobblemarket.finance.info_tip:
This screen manages finance, not trading
- Loan blocks: listed players cannot borrow
  (manual only - overdue / bad-debt blocking is separate,
  see All Loan History)
- Cards: revoke purple / black cards here
- Credits: adjust a player's credit limit
- Change Log: the ledger for the above
- Top Limits: the server's top 50 (to spot outliers)
Trading lives in Ban Management
